input: CSV containing exact Ped-sim IBD1 and IBD2 segments; no HBD; ancestry restricted to the pedigree
simulation: Sex-specific Bherer 2017 map and Campbell 2015 crossover interference

pair_domain_assessment.documented: Input is a segment CSV; no separate individual/pair roster is listed. Inference is requested for related pairs. The October correction removed retired-class pairs absent from the input.
pair_domain_assessment.inference: The operational observable domain is each distinct unordered pair present in the CSV. No identities are available for pairs absent from all supplied data. The wiki does not explicitly discuss a zero-IBD pair roster.
pair_domain_assessment.implementation: Require every input pair exactly once. If an independent supplied pair list contains extra pairs absent from the segments, fail explicitly; do not invent labels for those pairs.
